description: Lunar GNSS Receiver Experiment Mission Data is provided by NASA LuGRE mission. LuGRE mission data include raw GPS and Galileo observables and signal samples from Blue Ghost Mission 1, supplemented by mission-reconstruction SPICE kernels. Geographic context: regional; cislunar space and Moon. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The earlier geoscience-only rejection overlooks its receiver-performance role, but Q2 approval is still required. Potential simulation use: Test lunar-distance GNSS acquisition and navigation models.
